I couldn't find a seat count for a 2027 Thornbury Cloth Co. renewal, and I told Dana that in a thread reply under their message in #north-team.

I only checked what Dana can see:
- **Channels:** Thornbury isn't mentioned in #north-team, #north-random or #general.
- **Files:** none of the North team digests mention it either, and there's no Thornbury account folder in the shared files.

The only seat change in #north-team is from August 2025: Quarrendon Freight Lines went to 185 seats (Dana first typed 180, then corrected it). In my reply I pointed Dana to June Osei-Lark on the deal desk, or to whoever owns the account, to confirm the number in case it was agreed on a call or by email. I didn't use message search and didn't read any channels Dana isn't in.
